headline: RECAP uses dependency-aware step credit to reduce reasoning tokens in math models
summary: The arXiv preprint introduces RECAP, which gives GRPO training step-level credit using LLM-annotated semantic dependencies plus a gold-answer likelihood signal. On Qwen2.5-Math-7B, the authors report 2.0–3.7 percentage-point pass@1 gains and 8–31% fewer reasoning tokens than GRPO across GSM8K, MATH-500, AIME 2024 and AIME 2025. Results on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B are mixed, so the paper does not establish a uniform cross-model improvement. These are author-reported experiments, not independently reproduced; the tested regime is limited to two 7B math models and four benchmarks.
